update_title: We fixed some bugs and redesigned BetterToday
update_info:
We have redesigned BetterToday to make it more useful and bring you smoother experience.

 What is new?
- Complete UI and UX redesign.
- BTCadence - A Anki-like feature for spaced repetition learning and recalls.
- Question Bank.
- Study Tracker.
- App usage, devotion and reading streaks and badges.
- In-app notifications.
- Bug fixes.
- and more..
